newsitem.title: FRANCE: Foreign members of Bosnia-Herzegovina court named.
newsitem.headline: Foreign members of Bosnia-Herzegovina court named.

text.p: The European Court of Human Rights said on Thursday it had named a Swedish magistrate and law professors from France and Austria as international members of Bosnia-Herzegovina's Constitutional Court.
The three were named as Hans Danielius, member of the Swedish Supreme Court and of the European Commission of Human Rights and Professors Louis Favoreu of France and Joseph Marko of Austria.

Their appointment was agreed under the terms of last year's Dayton peace agreement for ex-Yugoslavia which said the three would join six members of the court to named locally by authorities in Bosnia-Herzegovina.
The court will rule in disputes which might arise including between Moslem, Croat and Serb communities in Bosnia-Herzegovina.
